t_advice_summary_textbox.text: To be successful in the game I need to select the gnome that has the yellow hat

vb_textbox.text: pay attention to the gnomes and the baskets. It is advisable to click the yellow basket gnomes, it gives more mushrooms. click the  s  button as fast as you can and click the space button as fast as you can. The yellow basket has orange, blue,green and yellow gnomes.
